imo-1978-q1.summary: Let $1\le m<n$ be positive integers. The final three decimal digits of $1978^m$ and $1978^n$ agree. Determine the pair $(m,n)$ for which $m+n$ is as small as possible.
imo-1978-q1.summaryZh: 设正整数 $1\le m<n$，且 $1978^m$ 与 $1978^n$ 的十进制末三位完全相同。求使 $m+n$ 最小的数对 $(m,n)$。
imo-1978-q1.answer: $m=3$, $n=103$, and the minimum value of $m+n$ is $106$.

methods.title: Separate the mod $8$ and mod $125$ conditions
methods.titleZh: 分别处理模 $8$ 与模 $125$ 的条件
steps: Put $d=n-m>0$. Equality of the last three digits is equivalent to $$1000\mid1978^n-1978^m=1978^m(1978^d-1).$$ Since $1000=8\cdot125$ and the factors are coprime, we may impose the two divisibility conditions separately.
Because $1978=2\cdot989$ and $1978^d-1$ is odd, the displayed difference contains exactly $m$ factors of $2$. Thus divisibility by $8$ is equivalent to $m\ge3$.
For the factor $125$, note that $1978$ is coprime to $125$. We need $1978^d\equiv1\pmod{125}$. Modulo $5$, this becomes $3^d\equiv1$, whose least positive period is $4$; hence write $d=4k$.
Modulo $125$ one finds $$1978^2\equiv109,\qquad1978^4\equiv6.$$ Therefore $6^k\equiv1\pmod{125}$. Reducing $(1+5)^k$ modulo $25$ gives $1+5k\equiv1$, so $5\mid k$; write $k=5t$.
Since $6^5=7776\equiv26=1+25\pmod{125}$, the congruence becomes $(1+25)^t\equiv1\pmod{125}$. Hence $1+25t\equiv1\pmod{125}$ and $5\mid t$. Consequently $100\mid d$.
Conversely, $$1978^{100}\equiv6^{25}\equiv26^5=(1+25)^5\equiv1\pmod{125},$$ so $d=100$ is attainable. We must therefore have $$m+n=2m+d\ge2\cdot3+100=106,$$ with equality at $(m,n)=(3,103)$.
stepsZh: 因为 $1978=2\cdot989$，而 $1978^d-1$ 是奇数，所以上式恰含 $m$ 个因子 $2$。因此被 $8$ 整除当且仅当 $m\ge3$。
对于因子 $125$，$1978$ 与 $125$ 互素，需要 $1978^d\equiv1\pmod{125}$。模 $5$ 后得到 $3^d\equiv1$，而 $3$ 模 $5$ 的最小正周期为 $4$，故可写 $d=4k$。
模 $125$ 计算得 $$1978^2\equiv109,\qquad1978^4\equiv6$$。因而 $6^k\equiv1\pmod{125}$。把 $(1+5)^k$ 模 $25$ 展开，得到 $1+5k\equiv1$，所以 $5\mid k$；令 $k=5t$。
又因 $6^5=7776\equiv26=1+25\pmod{125}$，上述同余化为 $(1+25)^t\equiv1\pmod{125}$。于是 $1+25t\equiv1\pmod{125}$，从而 $5\mid t$。故 $100\mid d$。

imo-1978-q2.summary: A point $P$ is fixed inside a sphere with centre $O$ and radius $R$. Three mutually perpendicular rays from $P$ meet the sphere at $U,V,W$. Let $Q$ be the vertex opposite $P$ in the rectangular parallelepiped generated by $PU,PV,PW$. Determine the complete locus of $Q$.
imo-1978-q2.summaryZh: 在圆心为 $O$、半径为 $R$ 的球内固定一点 $P$。从 $P$ 发出的三条两两垂直射线分别交球面于 $U,V,W$。以 $PU,PV,PW$ 为三条棱构成长方体，设 $Q$ 为与 $P$ 相对的顶点。求 $Q$ 的完整轨迹。
imo-1978-q2.answer: The entire sphere centred at $O$ with radius $\sqrt{3R^2-2OP^2}$.
imo-1978-q2.answerZh: 轨迹是以 $O$ 为球心、半径为 $\sqrt{3R^2-2OP^2}$ 的整个球面。

methods.title: Use an orthonormal frame and then prove every direction occurs
methods.titleZh: 建立标准正交标架，并证明每个方向都能达到
steps: Take $O$ as the origin. Let $\mathbf p,\mathbf q$ be the position vectors of $P,Q$, put $d=|\mathbf p|<R$, and set $c=R^2-d^2>0$. Let $\mathbf e_1,\mathbf e_2,\mathbf e_3$ be unit vectors along the three rays; they form an orthonormal basis.
Write $a_i=\mathbf p\cdot\mathbf e_i$, and let $t_i>0$ be the length from $P$ to the sphere along the $i$th ray. The equation $|\mathbf p+t_i\mathbf e_i|^2=R^2$ gives $$t_i=-a_i+\sqrt{a_i^2+c}.$$

Since $\mathbf p=\sum a_i\mathbf e_i$ and $\mathbf q=\mathbf p+\sum t_i\mathbf e_i$, we obtain $$\mathbf q=\sum_{i=1}^3\sqrt{a_i^2+c}\,\mathbf e_i.$$ Therefore $$|\mathbf q|^2=\sum(a_i^2+c)=d^2+3(R^2-d^2)=3R^2-2d^2.$$ Every possible $Q$ lies on the stated sphere.

It remains to prove that no points of this sphere are missing. If $d=0$, rotating any ray triad about $O$ rotates $Q$ through every direction, so the conclusion is immediate. Assume $d>0$ and put $\mathbf k=\mathbf p/d$.

Choose an orthonormal frame with $\mathbf e_1+\mathbf e_2+\mathbf e_3=\sqrt3\,\mathbf k$. Then $a_i=d/\sqrt3$ for all $i$, and the formula above gives $\mathbf q=r\mathbf k$, where $r=\sqrt{3R^2-2d^2}$.

Rotate this frame continuously through angles $0\le\theta\le\pi$ about a line through $P$ perpendicular to $OP$. At the end, each scalar product $a_i$ changes to $-d/\sqrt3$ and the sum of the three direction vectors becomes $-\sqrt3\mathbf k$, so the corresponding $Q$ moves continuously on the radius-$r$ sphere from $r\mathbf k$ to $-r\mathbf k$.

Hence the height $\mathbf q\cdot\mathbf k$ takes every value in $[-r,r]$. Given any target point $X$ on the sphere, first choose a position with the same height as $X$, then rotate the entire triad about the axis $OP$ to match its longitude. These rotations preserve $P$ and the original sphere, so every $X$ is attained.
stepsZh: 以 $O$ 为原点，设 $P,Q$ 的位置向量分别为 $\mathbf p,\mathbf q$，令 $d=|\mathbf p|<R$，并记 $c=R^2-d^2>0$。设三条射线方向的单位向量为 $\mathbf e_1,\mathbf e_2,\mathbf e_3$；它们构成标准正交基。
记 $a_i=\mathbf p\cdot\mathbf e_i$，并设从 $P$ 沿第 $i$ 条射线到球面的距离为 $t_i>0$。由 $|\mathbf p+t_i\mathbf e_i|^2=R^2$ 得 $$t_i=-a_i+\sqrt{a_i^2+c}$$。

因为 $\mathbf p=\sum a_i\mathbf e_i$ 且 $\mathbf q=\mathbf p+\sum t_i\mathbf e_i$，所以 $$\mathbf q=\sum_{i=1}^3\sqrt{a_i^2+c}\,\mathbf e_i$$。从而 $$|\mathbf q|^2=\sum(a_i^2+c)=d^2+3(R^2-d^2)=3R^2-2d^2$$。因此所有可能的 $Q$ 都在题述球面上。
还需证明该球面上的点无一遗漏。若 $d=0$，绕 $O$ 任意旋转射线三元组会使 $Q$ 同步旋转到任意方向，结论立即成立。以下设 $d>0$，令 $\mathbf k=\mathbf p/d$。
选取满足 $\mathbf e_1+\mathbf e_2+\mathbf e_3=\sqrt3\,\mathbf k$ 的标准正交标架。此时每个 $a_i=d/\sqrt3$，上式给出 $\mathbf q=r\mathbf k$，其中 $r=\sqrt{3R^2-2d^2}$。
把这组标架绕一条过 $P$ 且垂直于 $OP$ 的直线连续旋转，角度从 $0$ 变到 $\pi$。终点处每个 $a_i$ 变为 $-d/\sqrt3$，三个方向向量之和变为 $-\sqrt3\mathbf k$，故对应的 $Q$ 在半径为 $r$ 的球面上从 $r\mathbf k$ 连续移动到 $-r\mathbf k$。
因此高度 $\mathbf q\cdot\mathbf k$ 取得区间 $[-r,r]$ 中的每个值。给定球面上任意目标点 $X$，先取一个与 $X$ 高度相同的 $Q$，再把整个射线三元组绕轴 $OP$ 旋转到相同经度。旋转保持 $P$ 与原球不变，故每个 $X$ 都可以达到。

imo-1978-q3.summary: Two strictly increasing sequences $f(1),f(2),\ldots$ and $g(1),g(2),\ldots$ form a disjoint partition of all positive integers and satisfy $g(n)=f(f(n))+1$ for every $n\ge1$. Determine $f(240)$.
imo-1978-q3.summaryZh: 两个严格递增数列 $f(1),f(2),\ldots$ 与 $g(1),g(2),\ldots$ 的值域互不相交，且合起来恰为全部正整数，并满足对每个 $n\ge1$ 都有 $g(n)=f(f(n))+1$。求 $f(240)$。

methods.title: Derive a complementary Beatty pair
methods.titleZh: 导出一对互补 Beatty 数列
steps: Count the positive integers below $g(n)$. Since $g(n)-1=f(f(n))$, exactly $f(n)$ of them are values of $f$, while exactly $n-1$ are earlier values of $g$. The two ranges partition the positive integers, so $$g(n)-1=f(n)+(n-1),\qquad g(n)=f(n)+n.$$

This identity determines the pair uniquely. At stage $n$, $f(n)$ must be the least positive integer not among the earlier values $f(i),g(i)$: it is absent by strict increase, while any smaller unused value cannot be $f(i)$ or $g(i)$ with $i\ge n$. Then $g(n)=f(n)+n$ fixes the companion term.
Let $$\alpha=\frac{1+\sqrt5}{2},\qquad F(n)=\lfloor n\alpha\rfloor,\qquad G(n)=\lfloor n\alpha^2\rfloor.$$ Because $\alpha^2=\alpha+1$, we have $G(n)=F(n)+n$.

For an integer $m\ge0$, the number of $F$-terms not exceeding $m$ is $\lfloor(m+1)/\alpha\rfloor$, and the corresponding number for $G$ is $\lfloor(m+1)/\alpha^2\rfloor$. Since $$\frac1\alpha+\frac1{\alpha^2}=1,$$ the two irrational quantities inside the floors sum to $m+1$, so their floors sum to $m$.

Thus exactly $m$ values from the two sequences are at most $m$. Comparing the counts for $m$ and $m-1$ shows that every positive integer occurs exactly once. Hence $(F,G)$ is the required pair, and uniqueness gives $f(n)=\lfloor n\alpha\rfloor$.
stepsZh: 先计数小于 $g(n)$ 的正整数。由 $g(n)-1=f(f(n))$，其中恰有 $f(n)$ 个是 $f$ 的值，另有 $n-1$ 个是较早的 $g$ 值。两数列值域划分正整数，故 $$g(n)-1=f(n)+(n-1),\qquad g(n)=f(n)+n$$。
该恒等式唯一确定这对数列。在第 $n$ 步，$f(n)$ 必须是此前所有 $f(i),g(i)$ 中尚未出现的最小正整数：严格递增保证它尚未出现，而任何更小的未用整数也不可能来自下标 $i\ge n$。随后 $g(n)=f(n)+n$ 确定配对项。
令 $$\alpha=\frac{1+\sqrt5}{2},\qquad F(n)=\lfloor n\alpha\rfloor,\qquad G(n)=\lfloor n\alpha^2\rfloor$$。因为 $\alpha^2=\alpha+1$，所以 $G(n)=F(n)+n$。
对整数 $m\ge0$，不超过 $m$ 的 $F$ 项数为 $\lfloor(m+1)/\alpha\rfloor$，相应的 $G$ 项数为 $\lfloor(m+1)/\alpha^2\rfloor$。又因 $$\frac1\alpha+\frac1{\alpha^2}=1,$$ 两个取整号内的无理数之和为整数 $m+1$，故两个下取整之和为 $m$。
因此两数列合计恰有 $m$ 个值不超过 $m$。比较 $m$ 与 $m-1$ 的计数，知每个正整数恰出现一次。所以 $(F,G)$ 就是所求数列对；由唯一性，$f(n)=\lfloor n\alpha\rfloor$。

imo-1978-q4.summary: Triangle $ABC$ is isosceles with $AB=AC$. A circle is internally tangent to the circumcircle of $ABC$ and tangent to the sides $AB,AC$ at $P,Q$. Prove that the midpoint of $PQ$ is the incenter of $ABC$.
imo-1978-q4.summaryZh: 在等腰三角形 $ABC$ 中，$AB=AC$。另有一圆与三角形的外接圆内切，并分别在 $P,Q$ 处与边 $AB,AC$ 相切。证明：$PQ$ 的中点就是三角形 $ABC$ 的内心。
imo-1978-q4.answer: The midpoint of $PQ$ is the incenter of $\triangle ABC$.
imo-1978-q4.answerZh: $PQ$ 的中点是 $\triangle ABC$ 的内心。

methods.title: Compare three perpendicular distances on the symmetry axis
methods.titleZh: 在对称轴上比较到三边的垂直距离
steps: Let $D$ be the midpoint of $BC$, $M$ the midpoint of $PQ$, and $S$ the centre of the smaller circle, with radius $r$. Put $\theta=\tfrac12\angle BAC$. The line $AD$ is both the symmetry axis and the angle bisector of the triangle.
The tangent lengths from $A$ satisfy $AP=AQ$, so $P,Q$ are mirror images across $AD$. Hence $M\in AD$ and $PQ\perp AD$. Since $SP=SQ$, the centre $S$ also lies on $AD$.

Let $T\ne A$ be the other intersection of the ray $AD$ with the circumcircle. The circumcentre lies on $AD$, so $AT$ is a diameter. The two circle centres and their internal tangency point are collinear. The tangency point cannot be $A$, since in right triangle $ASP$ we have $r=AS\sin\theta<AS$; hence it is $T$ and $$AT=AS+r=AS(1+\sin\theta).$$

Because $AT$ is a diameter, $\angle ABT=90^\circ$. Thus $$AB=AT\cos\theta,\qquad AD=AB\cos\theta=AT\cos^2\theta.$$ Also, from right triangles $ASP$ and $APM$, $$AP=AS\cos\theta,\qquad AM=AP\cos\theta=AS\cos^2\theta.$$

Combining the preceding identities gives $$AM=\frac{AD}{1+\sin\theta}.$$ Therefore $$MD=AD-AM=AM\sin\theta.$$ On the other hand, because $AM$ is the angle bisector, the perpendicular distance from $M$ to each of $AB$ and $AC$ is also $AM\sin\theta$.
Thus the interior point $M$ has equal perpendicular distances to all three sides of $ABC$. This characterizes the incenter, so $M$ is the incenter.
stepsZh: 设 $D$ 为 $BC$ 的中点，$M$ 为 $PQ$ 的中点，$S$ 为小圆圆心，小圆半径为 $r$。令 $\theta=\tfrac12\angle BAC$。直线 $AD$ 既是等腰三角形的对称轴，也是顶角平分线。
由同一点 $A$ 引出的切线段相等，$AP=AQ$，所以 $P,Q$ 关于 $AD$ 对称。故 $M\in AD$ 且 $PQ\perp AD$。又因 $SP=SQ$，圆心 $S$ 也在 $AD$ 上。
设射线 $AD$ 与外接圆的另一个交点为 $T\ne A$。外心在 $AD$ 上，所以 $AT$ 是直径。内切两圆的圆心与切点共线。该切点不可能是 $A$，因为在直角三角形 $ASP$ 中 $r=AS\sin\theta<AS$；故切点为 $T$，且 $$AT=AS+r=AS(1+\sin\theta)$$。
因为 $AT$ 是直径，$\angle ABT=90^\circ$。于是 $$AB=AT\cos\theta,\qquad AD=AB\cos\theta=AT\cos^2\theta$$。再由直角三角形 $ASP$ 与 $APM$，有 $$AP=AS\cos\theta,\qquad AM=AP\cos\theta=AS\cos^2\theta$$。
合并上式得到 $$AM=\frac{AD}{1+\sin\theta}$$。因而 $$MD=AD-AM=AM\sin\theta$$。另一方面，$AM$ 是角平分线，所以 $M$ 到 $AB,AC$ 的垂直距离也都等于 $AM\sin\theta$。
因此内点 $M$ 到三角形三边的垂直距离相等。由内心的刻画，$M$ 就是三角形 $ABC$ 的内心。

imo-1978-q5.summary: Let $a_1,a_2,\ldots$ be pairwise distinct positive integers. Prove that for every $n\ge1$, $$\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{a_k}{k^2}\ge\sum_{k=1}^n\frac1k.$$
imo-1978-q5.summaryZh: 设 $a_1,a_2,\ldots$ 是两两不同的正整数。证明：对每个 $n\ge1$，都有 $$\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{a_k}{k^2}\ge\sum_{k=1}^n\frac1k$$。
imo-1978-q5.answer: The inequality holds for every $n$; equality occurs for the initial arrangement $a_k=k$ ($1\le k\le n$).
imo-1978-q5.answerZh: 不等式对每个 $n$ 都成立；当所考察的前 $n$ 项满足 $a_k=k$ 时取等号。

methods.title: Sort by an exchange argument
steps: Fix $n$ and consider all permutations of the numbers $a_1,\ldots,a_n$. Choose an ordering $b_1,\ldots,b_n$ that minimizes $\sum b_k/k^2$.

If $i<j$ but $b_i>b_j$, swapping these two entries changes the old sum minus the new sum by $$(b_i-b_j)\left(\frac1{i^2}-\frac1{j^2}\right)>0.$$ This contradicts minimality. Hence $b_1<b_2<\cdots<b_n$.
Distinct increasing positive integers satisfy $b_k\ge k$. Therefore $$\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{a_k}{k^2}\ge\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{b_k}{k^2}\ge\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{k}{k^2}=\sum_{k=1}^n\frac1k.$$
Equality throughout requires $b_k=k$ and also the minimizing pairing with the decreasing weights $1/k^2$; thus the original order must be $a_k=k$ for $1\le k\le n$.
stepsZh: 固定 $n$，考虑 $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ 的所有排列。取使 $\sum b_k/k^2$ 最小的一种排列 $b_1,\ldots,b_n$。
若 $i<j$ 但 $b_i>b_j$，交换这两项后，原和减去新和等于 $$(b_i-b_j)\left(\frac1{i^2}-\frac1{j^2}\right)>0$$，与最小性矛盾。因此 $b_1<b_2<\cdots<b_n$。
严格递增的正整数满足 $b_k\ge k$。所以 $$\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{a_k}{k^2}\ge\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{b_k}{k^2}\ge\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{k}{k^2}=\sum_{k=1}^n\frac1k$$。
所有不等号同时取等需要 $b_k=k$，且原序列已经按递减权重 $1/k^2$ 对应递增数值排列；因此前 $n$ 项必须满足 $a_k=k$。

methods.title: Count the integer levels of the numerators
methods.titleZh: 按分子跨过的整数层分层计数
steps: Use $a_i=\sum_{t\ge1}\mathbf1_{a_i\ge t}$ to write $$\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{a_i}{i^2}=\sum_{t\ge1}\sum_{i:a_i\ge t}\frac1{i^2}.$$ We only need the layers $1\le t\le n$.
Because the $a_i$ are distinct positive integers, at most $t-1$ of them can be smaller than $t$. Hence at least $n-t+1$ indices satisfy $a_i\ge t$.

Among all subsets of $n-t+1$ indices from $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the sum of $1/i^2$ is smallest for the largest indices $i=t,t+1,\ldots,n$. Therefore $$\sum_{i:a_i\ge t}\frac1{i^2}\ge\sum_{i=t}^n\frac1{i^2}.$$
Summing this estimate for $t=1,\ldots,n$ and reversing the order gives $$\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{a_i}{i^2}\ge\sum_{t=1}^n\sum_{i=t}^n\frac1{i^2}=\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{i}{i^2}=\sum_{i=1}^n\frac1i.$$
stepsZh: 利用 $a_i=\sum_{t\ge1}\mathbf1_{a_i\ge t}$，可写成 $$\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{a_i}{i^2}=\sum_{t\ge1}\sum_{i:a_i\ge t}\frac1{i^2}$$。只保留 $1\le t\le n$ 的各层即可得到下界。
因为 $a_i$ 是互不相同的正整数，小于 $t$ 的项至多有 $t-1$ 个。因此至少有 $n-t+1$ 个下标满足 $a_i\ge t$。
从 $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ 中选取 $n-t+1$ 个下标时，$1/i^2$ 之和在选取最大的下标 $i=t,t+1,\ldots,n$ 时最小。因此 $$\sum_{i:a_i\ge t}\frac1{i^2}\ge\sum_{i=t}^n\frac1{i^2}$$。
对 $t=1,\ldots,n$ 求和并交换求和次序，得到 $$\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{a_i}{i^2}\ge\sum_{t=1}^n\sum_{i=t}^n\frac1{i^2}=\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{i}{i^2}=\sum_{i=1}^n\frac1i$$。

imo-1978-q6.summary: A society has $1978$ members from six countries, numbered $1,2,\ldots,1978$. Prove that some member's number is either the sum of the numbers of two members from the same country as that member, or twice the number of one member from that country.
imo-1978-q6.summaryZh: 一个学会有来自六个国家的 $1978$ 名会员，编号为 $1,2,\ldots,1978$。证明：存在一名会员，其编号等于两名同国会员编号之和，或等于一名同国会员编号的两倍。
imo-1978-q6.answer: Such a member must always exist.
imo-1978-q6.answerZh: 满足条件的会员必定存在。

methods.title: Force a monochromatic triangle in a six-coloured complete graph
methods.titleZh: 在六色完全图中迫出单色三角形
steps: Give the six countries six colours. Form the complete graph on vertices $0,1,\ldots,1978$, colouring the edge $ij$ by the country of the member numbered $|i-j|$.

A monochromatic triangle with vertices $x<y<z$ solves the problem. Indeed, $$a=y-x,\qquad b=z-y,\qquad c=z-x$$ have the same colour and satisfy $c=a+b$. If $a\ne b$, $c$ is the sum of two member numbers; if $a=b$, then $c=2a$.

We prove that such a triangle exists. Suppose a complete graph on $M$ vertices uses at most $r$ colours and has no monochromatic triangle. Choose a vertex $v$. At least $\lceil(M-1)/r\rceil$ edges from $v$ share a colour. Among their other endpoints, no edge can use that colour, or it would complete a monochromatic triangle.
Thus a complete graph on $M$ vertices using at most $r$ colours contains a complete subgraph on at least $\lceil(M-1)/r\rceil$ vertices using at most $r-1$ colours.
Starting from $1979$ vertices and six colours, repeated application gives the guaranteed sizes $$1979\to330\to66\to17\to6\to3,$$ while the number of available colours drops from $6$ to $1$.

The final complete subgraph has at least three vertices and only one colour, so any three of its vertices form a monochromatic triangle. This contradicts the assumption and proves the required member exists.
stepsZh: 用六种颜色表示六个国家。在顶点 $0,1,\ldots,1978$ 上作完全图，并把边 $ij$ 染成编号为 $|i-j|$ 的会员所属国家的颜色。
若存在顶点为 $x<y<z$ 的单色三角形，就得到结论。事实上，$$a=y-x,\qquad b=z-y,\qquad c=z-x$$ 属于同一种颜色，且 $c=a+b$。若 $a\ne b$，则 $c$ 是两个会员编号之和；若 $a=b$，则 $c=2a$。
下面证明单色三角形必存在。设一个有 $M$ 个顶点、至多使用 $r$ 种颜色的完全图没有单色三角形。任选顶点 $v$，由抽屉原理，从 $v$ 出发的边中至少有 $\lceil(M-1)/r\rceil$ 条同色。它们的其他端点之间不能再出现这种颜色的边，否则会与 $v$ 构成单色三角形。
因此，有 $M$ 个顶点且至多使用 $r$ 色的完全图，必含一个至少有 $\lceil(M-1)/r\rceil$ 个顶点、至多使用 $r-1$ 色的完全子图。
从 $1979$ 个顶点和六种颜色开始，反复应用上一步，保证的顶点数依次为 $$1979\to330\to66\to17\to6\to3,$$ 同时可用颜色数从 $6$ 降到 $1$。
最终完全子图至少有三个顶点且只有一种颜色，所以任取三个顶点都构成单色三角形，与假设矛盾。故题目所述会员必然存在。
